card.name: Recurring intervals like every six months
card.fires_on: The word that completes a recurrence phrase, such as months in "every six months", intervals after regular, or ically in periodically. It appears mostly in monitoring and testing instructions, and also in general text about repeating events.

modes.label: Monitoring schedules
modes.description: Time unit or interval word ending a recurring-check phrase in label instructions.
modes.example: tests are recommended every six<< months>> for the duration of therapy.

modes.label: Regular or periodic wording
modes.description: Part of regular, periodic or similar words that say something is repeated.
modes.example: Period<<ically>> monitor hematologic and iron parameters.

modes.label: General repeating events
modes.description: Frequency phrases in non-medical web text, such as every few months or once in a while.

card.plain: It marks the end of phrases that say something happens at repeated intervals, like every six months or at regular intervals.
